# AI/ML Intern (Paid), Lahore

**Company:** a Lahore software house (example only)
**Location:** DHA Phase 8, Lahore (on-site)
**Type:** Paid internship, 3–6 months, PKR 40,000/month

## About the role
We're looking for a motivated AI/ML intern to help build data-driven features for our clients. You'll work with our data team on forecasting, NLP and internal tools.

## Responsibilities
- Clean, explore and analyse datasets using Python and pandas
- Build and evaluate machine-learning models (scikit-learn, LightGBM, XGBoost)
- Develop NLP features such as text classification and semantic search
- Build simple dashboards and demos in Streamlit
- Write clean, tested code using Git and pytest
- Document results and present findings to the team

## Required skills
- Python, pandas, NumPy
- Machine-learning fundamentals and model evaluation
- Git/GitHub
- Strong written and spoken English

## Preferred skills
- Time-series forecasting (Prophet, LightGBM)
- NLP or embeddings (sentence-transformers, Hugging Face)
- Streamlit or another web framework
- Basic HTML/CSS
- SQL
- Experience with LLMs or prompt engineering

## Education and experience
- Students or fresh graduates in Computer Science, AI or a related field
- 0–1 years of experience; personal projects count
